title: Fixed Curved-Neck Frame Harp
description: One original complete fixed standing frame-harp display with a broad ground foot, a long turned forepillar, one continuous gently curved neck, an inclined tapered soundbox exterior and eighteen separate unequal-length strings joined to small neck pins and the sloping soundboard. The large triangular free-string field is a different whole structure from a closed waisted guitar or violin with a fingerboard, or an upright keyboard case. New whole geometry, no old instrument mesh imported. The soundbox is a closed stylized exterior; no hollow acoustic cavity is claimed. All strings and pins are static visual geometry: no sound, tuning, note range, tension, lever action, playability, standard instrument dimensions, manufacture or structural safety claim.
